caption: The drawing consists of two black-and-white line illustrations on a plain, light background. On the left, there is a tall streetlamp with a narrow pole, a square base, and a lantern-shaped lamp at the top. The lamp features a transparent glass casing with a faceted shape, and an eagle figure is perched on the top. Inside the lamp, a decorative central burner or light fixture is visible. On the right, a larger, detailed view of the lamp is shown, highlighting its faceted glass panels, supporting frame, eagle ornament on the top, and the inner burner with a handle and decorative design. The enlarged lamp is shown without the pole, focusing on the form and structure of the glass enclosure, metal supports, and ornamental details. Both illustrations are composed only with black ink lines and shading, with no additional colors present.
title: Eagle Lamp and Post
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
